WITH scan_site_matched AS (
  SELECT 
    s.scancount,
    s.gbsize,
    s.spanmin,
    si.healtheval
  FROM scans s
  INNER JOIN sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry
),
status_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    healtheval,
    SUM(scancount) as total_scancount,
    SUM(gbsize) / NULLIF(SUM(spanmin), 0) as rate
  FROM scan_site_matched
  GROUP BY healtheval
),
avg_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) as average_rate
  FROM status_stats
)
SELECT 
  healtheval,
  total_scancount,
  rate,
  rate - (SELECT average_rate FROM avg_rate) as rate_minus_avg
FROM status_stats
WHERE rate > (SELECT average_rate FROM avg_rate)
